does_not_establish: either V4.1 ROM deployment: neither was built, so no digest, no inverse proof and no schedule certificate exists for V4.1-Flash itself
anything about the resident region's row sharding on real bytes: the sharded object source is refused for want of per-shard authentication and the checkpoint is not on this disk
anything about execution, numerics or rate for V4.1 on any target
establishes: the double count, measured on the real V4.1 IR: 202,758,032,400 resident bytes equal to the capability's declared resident region to the byte, and a ROM image of 298,625,150,976 (72.4%) instead of 501,383,183,376 (121.6%)

the residency contract change, exercised end to end on the wafer fixture: build, independent verifier, schedule certificate with shared_state_locality and resident_hbm_region both true, inverse proof covering the resident bytes bit-identically, and a byte-identical rebuild
that the shipped DeepSeek-V4-Flash wafer and Qwen3-8B ROM digests are unmoved

preserved: inverse.py proves a resident region under the identical tiling, bit-identical reconstruction, zero-padding, independent content-digest and placement-uniqueness rules, and additionally refuses an object that backs both stores

check.py's resident_hbm_region keeps immutability / no-STATE / no-SCATTER and adds: on a machine that prices a resident region, the table objects must be HBM objects owned by a resident region of the plan, and the reserve must fit the declared bytes
a plan with no resident region emits byte-for-byte the record it emitted before, so plan_id and the deployment digest cannot move for V4 or Qwen3
contract_change.rule: a region of the plan declares a residency; a resident region's object is StorageClass.HBM with the same READ|IMMUTABLE permissions, is planned, placed, digest-bound and proved under the same rules as a ROM region, and is excluded from rom_bytes.  Residency is decided by the capability declaring memory.hbm.resident_region_bytes, and the tensor set is derived structurally (a checkpoint-bound weight operand of a LAYERED embedding lookup) -- no model number is written into a predicate.

measured_array.probe_note: the ROM side is measured with the resident region unsharded, because the row-sharded form is refused; the probe changes where the resident bytes are placed, not which bytes leave the ROM image
